items.title: The scheme theoretic image of a partial section is an isomorphism over the domain of the section
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a separated morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S, an open subspace V with V -> Y quasi-compact and a section s : V -> X of f over V, the scheme theoretic image Y' of s is an isomorphism over V (source lines 3382-3390). The proof shows that s is quasi-compact by the permanence statement, hence the construction of the scheme theoretic image commutes with restriction to opens; therefore Y' intersect f^{-1}(V) is the scheme theoretic image of a section of the separated morphism f^{-1}(V) -> V, and since a section of a separated morphism is a closed immersion, that image map is an isomorphism.
